field_evidence.semantic_limit: application extent / approximate application polygon; not distinct planned-building footprint

evidence_slice: Nottingham City Council MapServer layer 14 is named Planning Application Polygons, uses polygon geometry in EPSG:27700, and exposes APP_REF, APP_ADDRESS, PROPOSAL, APP_STATUS and DECISION fields. The council description says the polygons are approximate planning/application extents for internal use, may differ from actual application site boundaries, and should be checked against application plans. Therefore this layer is not accepted as a distinct proposed/incomplete-building footprint source.
rejection_reason: official polygon is an application/approximate application extent, not a distinct planned or incomplete building footprint; no application/site/unit value counted as a building
